items.headline: Ravens rule out Lamar Jackson (ankle) vs. Bengals; Tyler 'Snoop' Huntley to start
items.description: The Baltimore Ravens have ruled QB Lamar Jackson out of Sundays game vs. the Cincinnati Bengals as he continues to deal with a high ankle sprain. Tyler "Snoop" Huntley will get the start.

items.headline: Ravens' Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) unsure if he'll play
items.description: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson said he's dealing with a high ankle sprain and is unsure if he'll play this week against the Bengals, but is "heading in the right direction" after missing the past two games.
